a: gauṇa a. (ṇī f.) [guṇamadhikṛtya pravṛttā gauṇī, tata āgataḥ aṇ] 1 Subordinate, secondary, unessential. 2 (In gram.) Indirect or less immediate (opp. mukhya or pradhāna); gauṇe karmaṇi duhyādeḥ pradhāne nīhṛkṛṣvahāṃ Sk. 3 Figurative, metaphorical, used in a secondary sense (as a word or  sense). 4 Founded on some resemblance between the primary and secondary sense of a word; as in gauṇīlakṣaṇā. 5 Relating to enumeration or multiplication. 6 Attributive. Comp. — pakṣaḥ the minor or weaker side of an argument &c.
